title: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
abstract: arXiv:2611.32085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. translated_title: ExpGuard：保护长程大语言模型智能体免受受损经验的危害
translated_abstract: 长程大语言模型（LLM）智能体会将过去的轨迹提炼为可复用的经验。源轨迹中的误导性或对抗性指导可能会污染这些经验，使有害指令在多个任务之间持续存在并影响智能体未来的行动。评估潜在受损经验的风险面临三大挑战：（1）在经验复用之前建模来源（provenance）和执行依赖关系，（2）从轨迹结果中学习任务条件化的风险，以及（3）在在线推理阶段修复有风险的经验。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ExpGuard，一个用于检索触发的经验风险评估与在线修复的框架。具体而言，针对挑战（1），ExpGuard在任务条件化的异构图中将经验语义与来源和执行依赖关系相结合，以在经验复用之前预测攻击风险和任务失败风险。为实现任务条件化的风险评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: ExpGuard提出了一种检索触发的经验风险评估与在线修复框架，通过任务条件化异构图整合经验语义、来源与执行依赖关系，在经验复用前预测攻击和任务失败风险，从而保护长程LLM智能体免受被污染经验的持续危害。
en_tdlr: ExpGuard is a retrieval-triggered framework for experience risk assessment and online repair that integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph, predicting attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse to guard long-horizon LLM agents against corrupted experiences.
